states.flutter: No Dart source — origin: web-only, flutterSources is []. There is no Flutter workspace composite whose interaction states could be read.
states.web: State lives in the reply that has it: Shimmer while waiting for the first event, Reasoning and the tool chain while working, the run Task inline, approvals inside their Tool. A reply whose run is paused or waiting (RUN_IN_FLIGHT, reply-model.ts) is not finished — no actions or follow-ups. Run completion and a restored connection are toasts. Busy sends route to transport.enqueue when the transport has a queue.
states.note: A composite block's states are the union of its parts' states, and each part (Plan, Queue, EffectLedger, …) already carries its own state table on its own page — duplicating that table here would drift the moment any one part's states change.

interaction.web: Pointer and keyboard belong to the parts: the composer submits on Enter, opens the @ and / palettes from a word-start keystroke, and moves Search/model/Effort/meter under the box below 448px; the Sidebar toggles from its trigger (44px) and is a Sheet on a phone; toast actions do not dismiss an open Sheet or Dialog.
